description: What scripts/safe-copies.py copies of this repository's own work, and of which kind (phobos-modkit docs/safe-copies.md). The owner's choices of 21 Nov 2026: own files to K: and the private repository dthorga-safe-copies; anything made from the game's art to K: only. A training is own only when its manifest's hashes prove every picture in it is one of our picks (lora_experiment.py picks writes the manifest and the marker). RimWorld's own files (the saves, its Config folder and RimSort's lists) are the game's, not this repository's: since kit 1.71.0 they are in phobos-modkit's config/safe-copies/rimworld.json, with the same set names, so their copies stayed as they were.
